purpose_ja: 通常 final の GPU37–39 を維持し、新 placement 実装前に 37 eligible CPU 層の joint routes と、別段階で CPU/GPU readiness の観測可能範囲を決める。
not_authorization: 過去の Pro 提案は新しいユーザー指示として扱わない。新しい hot1 起動・API 再起動・配置採用を自動化しない。

fixed_configuration.note: An instrumented diagnostic binary necessarily has a different byte hash; record it and compare an instrumentation-off run of that same binary. Do not pretend it is the unchanged normal API binary.

stages.purpose: Fresh read-only identity and capacity screening, without CUDA context creation or allocations
cannot_prove: actual cudaMemGetInfo free in a new diagnostic context
stages.positive_private_guard_unchanged: actual free > payload + 3072 MiB before bank allocation and free > 2560 MiB after warmup

stages.status: first_collector_candidate; requires a future diagnostic build/start window

code_hook.placement: ith==0 after the host IDs loop, before the existing barrier at 1853

stages.projection: ffn_gate_exps only; no gate/up/down triple counting
stages.type_scope: all eligible gate types including MXFP4; not limited to IQ2_S

capture_policy.sample_unit: whole contiguous decode token/eval attempt across all 37 eligible layers
capture_policy.overflow: increment dropped/overflow, mark whole run invalid, do not overwrite old records

stages.lifecycle: Publish immutable eval tag before each actual graph execution, not only graph construction. Cross-thread publication is explicit; thread-local parent state is insufficient. One context and one active eval are the initial supported scope.
stages.registration: Bind actual gate weight tensor/data identity, layer, type and geometry outside the measured operator. Version mapping on graph generation; copied/unknown tensors or duplicate bindings invalidate the capture rather than guessing from a hot-path regex.
outputs: ordered six global expert IDs per token/layer
offline_only_derivations: H histogram 0..6 for each frozen hypothetical plan

stages.status: optional coverage oracle or future placement scope; not mandatory for GPU37-39-fixed plan candidates
stages.ask_callback: true only for explicit target top-k tensors and selected eval attempts; validate graph-view visitation in smoke
stages.post_callback: read six I32 IDs respecting view strides after scheduler synchronization, using fixed buffer
stages.known_perturbation: SCHEDULER:2177-2202 partitions graph views and synchronizes; non-null callback also synchronizes the terminal view even if ask=false there
stages.forbidden_shortcut: COMMON_DEBUG ask always true at 150-152; its regex filter is post-execution and does not avoid all-node synchronization/copy
stages.latency_inference: excluded; this is explicitly a perturbed callback run

stages.status: later conditional stage, not a current run recommendation
prerequisites: actual unchanged private reserve guards pass
one bounded operator or explicitly enumerated layers; no automatic placement adoption
stages.host_scope: inner State.compute starts with host input and IDs available; ends with canonical six-slot unweighted host FFN output

host_hooks.where: after CPU input/IDs set; absent if H=6
before pinned input copy; absent if H=0
after D2H enqueue; absent if H=0
before CPU graph call; absent if H=6
after synchronous CPU graph return; absent if H=6
after CPU output copy; absent if H=6
before existing stream synchronize; absent if H=0
after existing stream synchronize; absent if H=0
after hot-slot scatter; H=0 uses end of already-complete CPU output
after existing first-call logger/counters; first call separately marked

stages.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC nanoseconds, or a single explicitly identified steady clock throughout; do not mix epochs
stages.join_meaning: residual host wait plus call overhead, and an upper bound on completion; not true GPU ready time
stages.allowed_ideal_formula: max(cpu_ready_from_common_start, gpu_ready_from_common_start) + merge; branch start times need not coincide; true gpu_ready may remain unknown
stages.exact_host_accounting: Use successive host boundaries for a non-overlapping wall decomposition; keep enqueue, CPU phase, residual join, scatter and unassigned gaps separate

optional_device_events.interface: proposed tiny backend-local helper on actual cuda_ctx->stream(); no assumed public stream getter or cross-library context cast
optional_device_events.event_kind: new timing-enabled events, not existing disable-timing backend events
optional_device_events.resolve: after existing HOT_CPP:175 synchronization; no new device synchronize, event synchronize, or polling loop
optional_device_events.epoch: GPU elapsed-time domain; no host epoch is provided
prohibited: adding event elapsed to host enqueue start to invent exact readiness
summing GPU elapsed with overlapping host CPU or residual join time
calling GPU interval pure kernel occupancy
optional_device_events.graph_compatibility: bracket the backend graph call, outside its capture region; record direct/capture/replay and graph generation. Kernel-loop-only instrumentation vanishes on replay.
optional_device_events.lifetime: preallocate pool before warmup, stamp event generations, resolve before reuse. Existing dispatcher mutex, normal join, error-path synchronization and destructor synchronization remain intact.

optional_single_query.point: after CPU output ready and before existing GPU join, for 0<H<6 only
optional_single_query.success: E3 completion occurred no later than query_end; it may be before or after CPU output readiness
optional_single_query.not_ready: E3 was still pending at a point within the query window; pending is not an exact GPU completion epoch or proof that D2H itself was incomplete
optional_single_query.classification: ready/pending/error at query window; strict CPU-vs-GPU completion order remains unknown unless separate bounds establish it

stages.outer_scope_separate: Scheduler input waits/copies before State.compute and subsequent GPU weight/reduction tail are excluded from inner timing; use existing split/copy boundary markers without new callback cuts if whole FFN path is later measured
stages.overlap_claim: Asynchronous enqueue and small join do not alone prove CPU/GPU execution overlap. Controlled serial/concurrent same-placement twins show conditional wall benefit; a correlated device/host activity trace is a later stronger temporal proof.

route_record_v1_proposed_layout.format: 128-byte fixed record, implementation must static_assert and specify endianness; JSON is exported after capture
route_validation: complete successful decode attempt has exactly37 unique layers
failed/retried attempts retain distinct IDs and are not silently deduplicated

trace_validation_and_stops.unexpected_missing_layer: invalid trace, not zero hit count
trace_validation_and_stops.drop_or_overflow: invalid complete joint trace; preserve partial evidence with explicit status
stop_on: API becomes active during auxiliary diagnostic
non-success CUDA status other than query NotReady
trace_validation_and_stops.overhead_control: For a future executable collector, compare capture disabled/enabled in the same diagnostic binary and fixed placement, with prospectively bounded off/on/on/off order. Separate host-only and event variants. Do not remove adverse samples or infer whole-model speed from route capture.
